validationQueries.sql:
SELECT 'customers' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.customers
UNION ALL SELECT 'products', COUNT(*) FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.products
UNION ALL SELECT 'plants', COUNT(*) FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.plants
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_orders', COUNT(*) FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.sales_orders
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_order_lines', COUNT(*) FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.sales_order_lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'work_orders', COUNT(*) FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.work_orders
UNION ALL SELECT 'shipments', COUNT(*) FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.shipments
UNION ALL SELECT 'shipment_lines', COUNT(*) FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.shipment_lines

SELECT
SUM(ordered_quantity) AS ordered_quantity,
SUM(line_amount) AS order_amount
FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.sales_order_lines

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.sales_orders
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(l.line_amount) AS order_amount
FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.customers c
JOIN `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.sales_orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY c.customer_id

SELECT p.plant_id, p.plant_name,
SUM(w.planned_quantity) AS planned_quantity,
SUM(w.produced_quantity) AS produced_quantity
FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.plants p
JOIN `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.work_orders w ON w.plant_id = p.plant_id
GROUP BY p.plant_id, p.plant_name
ORDER BY p.plant_id

SELECT l.order_line_id, l.ordered_quantity,
COALESCE(s.shipped_quantity, 0) AS shipped_quantity,
l.ordered_quantity - COALESCE(s.shipped_quantity, 0) AS backlog_quantity
FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.sales_order_lines l
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT order_line_id, SUM(shipped_quantity) AS shipped_quantity
FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.shipment_lines
GROUP BY order_line_id
) s ON s.order_line_id = l.order_line_id
ORDER BY l.order_line_id

SELECT customer_id, customer_name
FROM `dbw_contoso_mfg_demo_eus2`.`manufacturing_managed_demo`.customers
WHERE customer_id = 1
